AAPL.name: AAPL
notes: Target: annualised realised volatility over the next 21 trading days (zero-mean, log returns).
Locked test window 2024-10-21 – 2026-10-23 (504 forecast dates; 24 non-overlapping).
GARCH innovations: t (chosen on development data only).
GARCH is re-estimated every 21 days on an expanding window; the LSTM is trained once on development data and not re-trained during the test window.
Intervals are 10–90 % (nominal 80 %). GARCH intervals omit parameter uncertainty; LSTM intervals are conformally calibrated on development data.
Latest GARCH forecast uses parameters re-estimated on all data; the latest LSTM forecast uses the model validated above.
